description: This file defines a custom Lexical Node for embedding Twitter tweets as React components within a rich text editor. It includes the TweetNode class, React components for rendering tweets, and functions for conversion and serialization.

classes.name: TweetNode
classes.description: A Lexical decorator node for embedding a tweet identified by its ID. Handles serialization, DOM conversion, and React decoration.

methods.name: $createTweetNode
methods.description: Creates a new instance of TweetNode with a specified tweet ID.

methods.name: $isTweetNode
methods.description: Type guard to check if a node is an instance of TweetNode.
